consumer_contract.classification_basis: Eleven read-only formulas and roughness member/string mappings are direct native equivalents. The remaining twenty-four symbols require explicit adaptations because pinned Python accepts mutable names and collections, aliases mutable child objects, permits bool and nonfinite values through several validators, has distinct validation order and error timing, accepts empty constructions, and models roughness as a string Enum rather than a strongly typed native enum.
